messages:
sarah_sales: Hey team, Acme procurement just asked for a single bundle we can hand them for the POC — they want SOC 2 artifacts, ISO 27001 cert, and a signed penetration-test attestation they can keep on file. Deadline EOD Friday. Any chance we can assemble and hand off a branded zip with an attestation letter?

omar_se: We have most of this but need to collate/redact. Current assets: SOC2 Type II (2024) redacted PDF, ISO 27001 cert jpg, security whitepaper, pen-test report (from ForgeSec) — full report is restricted. We can generate a short attestation letter referencing the pen-test engagement and include a vendor-signed letter if procurement insists.

lina_compliance: I can assemble an "assurance packet" and provide a one-page attestation for POCs. Need answers: 1) Do they require the full ForgeSec report or just a vendor attestation? 2) Who signs on Redwood side (legal needs sign-off). Also confirm if customer needs SLA language included. I can turn around a draft in ~24–48 hrs if we have approvals.

trent_engineering: FYI — Acme's POC includes our Private offering with customer-managed KMS. Procurement often asks for an architecture/controls diagram showing keys never leave their VPC. I'll attach the architecture svg to the packet. Also note: for the pen-test attestation, include this blurb about deployment isolation and log retention: `We do not export customer KMS keys; logs are stored in region us-west-2 w/ customer retention controls.`

omar_se: To answer Lina — procurement initially asked for vendor-signed pen-test letter + brief summary of findings (high-level, no raw vuln data). So no full report required. They also want confirmation that we completed remediation on any critical/high findings since last test. We have a remediation summary in Confluence.

lina_compliance: Perfect. Two action items for me: 1) Draft attestation referencing the ForgeSec engagement and remediation summary, 2) Create a minimal evidence index (SOC2 page numbers, ISO cert image, whitepaper link, arch diagram). I will need Legal to OK the attestation wording — @sarah_sales can you loop in legal?

sarah_sales: Looping in legal now — cc: @legal_team (I pinged them in DM). Also procurement asked if we can include a short note on pricing impact if they want Dedicated/reserved capacity for the POC vs hosted. Can someone supply a short sentence we can add to the packet?

dustin_sales: Quick note on pricing: For POCs we usually offer a limited-time Dedicated trial with a discounted commit — can state: "Dedicated trial pricing and commitment details available on request; discounts may apply for POC engagements." Want to keep it high-level in the assurance packet.

lina_compliance: Draft template for attestation I'll use (will replace placeholders):
```
[Date]
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference attests that a third-party penetration test (ForgeSec) covering the hosted and private inference control plane was performed on [engagement dates]. No critical findings remain open as of [date]; remediation summary is attached. The report is held under strict access controls; a vendor-signed attestation and summary are provided for customer use.
Sincerely,
Redwood Inference — Compliance Team
```

omar_se: I'll drop the remediation summary link here: https://confluence.internal/redwood/security/forgesec-remediation (access: internal only).

auditbot: Evidence request created: EVID-4321. Assigned to lina_compliance. Due 1911199999.

lina_compliance: I'll stage the packet to the secure S3 presign area and share a short-lived link for procurement reviewers. Expect a zip with: 1) SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf, 2) ISO27001_cert.jpg, 3) Attestation_letter_signed_draft.pdf (RB legal to sign), 4) Remediation_summary.pdf, 5) Arch_diagram.svg, 6) Short pricing blurb.txt.

trent_engineering: Small note — include a one-line statement about telemetry: `Only aggregated and anonymized telemetry is processed for performance metrics; no customer input is used for model training.` Procurement likes that.

lina_compliance: Good call. Adding that. Also: presigned link (expires 7 days): https://internal-s3.redwood.net/presign/EVID-4321/assurance-packet.zip?exp=7d (do not share publicly).

sarah_sales: Love it. I'll forward the presigned link to Acme procurement and confirm legal signature timing. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark: 

dustin_sales: If procurement pushes for the full pen-test report, we will escalate to Legal & Security for an NDA redaction flow.

omar_se: Thanks — will prepare the remediation summary for Lina.

lina_compliance: Draft is ready — need legal signature. Tagging for follow-up: EVID-4321 will be updated when signed.

sarah_sales: Acknowledged. I'll close the loop once legal signs. :thumbsup:
